exercises.explanationUz:
UNIT MAVZUSI — HAYVONLAR.

Sarlavha: 'Birds of a Feather!'
Bu maqolning qisqartmasi: 'Birds of a feather flock together'
  so'zma-so'z: bir xil patli qushlar birga uchadi
  ma'nosi: o'xshash odamlar birga bo'ladi

RO'YXAT: dolphin, lion, parrot, penguins

RASMLAR:
  A — suvdan sakrab chiqayotgan kulrang jonivor
  B — qizil, sariq va ko'k patli qush
  C — qora-oq rangli, tik turgan qushlar guruhi
  D — sariq yeli bor katta mushuksimon hayvon

exercises.instructionEn: Which of them are birds? mammals? Which of them have fur, fins, a tail, skin, feathers, wings, a mane, legs? Which of them can fly, run, swim?
exercises.instructionUz: Ulardan qaysilari qush? sutemizuvchi? Qaysilarida jun, suzgich, dum, teri, pat, qanot, yol, oyoq bor? Qaysilari ucha, yugura, suza oladi?
exercises.explanationUz:
HAYVON TANASI QISMLARI:
  fur      — jun (sutemizuvchilarda)
  fins     — suzgichlar (baliq va delfinda)
  a tail   — dum
  skin     — teri (junsiz)
  feathers — patlar (qushlarda)
  wings    — qanotlar
  a mane   — yol (sherning bo'ynidagi soch)
  legs     — oyoqlar

IKKI GURUH HAYVON:
  birds (qushlar)      — pat va qanoti bor, tuxum qo'yadi
  mammals (sutemizuvchilar) — bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi

QIZIQ FAKTLAR:
  • Delfin — BALIQ EMAS, sutemizuvchi!
  • Pingvin — QUSH, lekin UCHA OLMAYDI!
  • Delfinning OYOG'I YO'Q va JUNI YO'Q — terisi bor.

tasks.whyUz: Qushlarda pat va qanot bor, tuxum qo'yadi. To'tiqush va pingvin — qush.
Sutemizuvchilar bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi. Delfin BALIQ EMAS — sutemizuvchi!
'fur' = jun. Faqat sherda. Delfinda teri (skin) bor, jun yo'q.
'fins' = suzgichlar. Suzishga yordam beradi.

tasks.prompt: Which of them have a tail?
tasks.whyUz: To'rttasida ham dum bor: delfin, sher, to'tiqush, pingvin.

tasks.prompt: Which of them have skin (without fur)?
tasks.whyUz: Matnda: 'They've got grey skin'. Delfinda jun yo'q — silliq teri.
'feathers' = patlar. Faqat qushlarda bo'ladi.
Pingvinda ham qanot BOR, lekin u ucha olmaydi — qanotlari suzish uchun.

tasks.prompt: Which of them have a mane?
tasks.whyUz: 'a mane' = yol (bo'yin sochi). Faqat ERKAK sherda bo'ladi.

tasks.answer: the lion, the parrot and the penguins
options: the lion, the parrot and the penguins
tasks.whyUz: Delfinda oyoq YO'Q. Matnda: 'They haven't got legs'.
Pingvin qush, lekin UCHA OLMAYDI. Matnda: 'they can't fly!'
Sher tez yuguradi. Pingvin yura oladi, lekin yugurmaydi.
Ikkalasi ham juda yaxshi suzadi. Matnda: 'They can swim very well'.

exercises.instructionEn: First, read these sentences, then listen and mark them as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Avval bu gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglab, T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir gapni matndagi aniq ma'lumot bilan solishtiring.

CHALG'ITUVCHI JUFTLIKLAR:
  fur ↔ skin        (delfinda TERI, jun emas)
  wings — pingvinda BOR, lekin ucha olmaydi
  ten ↔ twenty years
exercises.audioNoteUz: Kitobda audio bor. Barcha javoblarni 3-mashqdagi matnlardan ham topish mumkin.

tasks.whyUz: TO'G'RI. Matnning birinchi gapi: 'Dolphins are mammals.'
TO'G'RI. Matnda: 'Dolphins are not fish, but they live in water.'
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda 'grey SKIN' (teri), 'fur' (jun) EMAS. Delfinda jun yo'q.
TO'G'RI. Matnda: 'they eat fish'.
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'they've got wings'. Qanoti BOR, lekin ucha olmaydi.
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'they CAN'T fly!' Bu pingvinni g'ayrioddiy qush qiladi.
TO'G'RI. Matnda: 'Penguins live on the ice of Antarctica'.

tasks.prompt: 8  Penguins live for about ten years.
tasks.whyUz: NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'about TWENTY years'. O'n emas, yigirma.
tasks.speak: 8  Penguins live for about ten years.

exercises.instructionEn: Which of these animals are reptiles/mammals/insects/birds?
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT GURUH:
  reptiles  — sudralib yuruvchilar (timsoh, ilon, kaltakesak)
              teri qattiq va tangachali, tuxum qo'yadi
  mammals   — sutemizuvchilar (ot, maymun, mushuk, it, sigir)
              bola tug'adi, sut bilan boqadi, juni bor
  insects   — hasharotlar (kapalak, ari, chumoli)
              olti oyoq, ko'pincha qanot bor
  birds     — qushlar (xo'roz, burgut, to'tiqush)
              pat, qanot, tumshuq; tuxum qo'yadi

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA: 'Crocodiles are reptiles.'
DIQQAT: gap KO'PLIKDA tuziladi — Crocodile'S are reptile'S'.

tasks.whyUz: Ilon — sudralib yuruvchi. Timsoh bilan bir guruhda.

Kapalak — hasharot. Qanoti bor, lekin qush EMAS: pati yo'q, olti oyog'i bor.
'butterfly' → ko'plikda 'butterflies' (y → ies).
Xo'roz — qush. Pat, qanot va tumshug'i bor.
Ot bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi.
'monkey' → ko'plikda 'monkeys' (unlidan keyin y → faqat -s).
Mushuk — sutemizuvchi, juni bor.
It — sutemizuvchi.
Sigir sut beradi — eng aniq sutemizuvchi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the list of words below, then label the parts of the animals' bodies. What are the names of these animals?
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'zlarni o'qing, so'ng hayvonlar tanasi qismlarini belgilang. Bu hayvonlarning nomlari nima?
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLAR RO'YXATI: paws, feathers, fur, tail, beak, ears

RASMDA UCHTA HAYVON BOR:
  Yuqorida — yirtqich qush (an eagle)
  O'rtada  — yo'lbars (a tiger)
  Pastda   — kenguru (a kangaroo)

KITOBDA BERILGAN YORLIQLAR:
  Qush:    sharp claws (o'tkir tirnoqlar), wings (qanotlar)
  Yo'lbars: whiskers (mo'ylovlar), black stripes (qora chiziqlar)
  Kenguru:  front legs (old oyoqlar), pouch (xalta),
            back legs (orqa oyoqlar), feet (panjalar)

DIQQAT — QAYSI HAYVONDA QAYSI SO'Z:
  beak, feathers — faqat QUSHDA
  fur, paws      — faqat SUTEMIZUVCHIDA
  tail, ears     — ko'p hayvonda

tasks.whyUz: Strelka qushning boshi oldidagi tumshuqqa ko'rsatadi. 'a beak' — faqat qushda bo'ladi.
Strelka qushning tanasini qoplagan qismga ko'rsatadi. Doim ko'plikda: 'feathers'.
Strelka yo'lbarsning tanasini qoplagan qismga ko'rsatadi. 'fur' — sanalmaydigan ot, -s YO'Q.
Strelka yo'lbarsning old oyog'i uchiga ko'rsatadi. 'paws' — mushuksimonlar va itlarning panjasi.
Strelka kenguruning boshidagi uzun qismlarga ko'rsatadi.
Strelka kenguruning orqasidagi yo'g'on qismga ko'rsatadi. Kenguru u bilan tayanadi.

exercises.instructionEn: What are the names of these animals?

tasks.prompt: Yuqoridagi hayvon (tumshuq, patlar, qanotlar, o'tkir tirnoqlar):
tasks.whyUz: Burgut — yirtqich qush. Tumshug'i egri, tirnoqlari o'tkir.

tasks.prompt: O'rtadagi hayvon (jun, panjalar, mo'ylovlar, qora chiziqlar):
tasks.whyUz: Yo'lbars — qora chiziqlari bilan tanib olinadi.

tasks.prompt: Pastdagi hayvon (quloqlar, dum, xalta, orqa oyoqlar):
tasks.whyUz: Kenguru — xaltasi (pouch) bor yagona hayvon. Avstraliyada yashaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: lay, short, intelligent, keep, have, big, warm, look, parts, thick

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  1–6 — bo'shliqdan keyin OT bor → SIFAT yoki OT kerak
  7–10 — oldida 'to' bor → FE'L kerak

  intelligent, thick, short, big, warm — sifatlar
  parts — ot
  keep, look, lay, have — fe'llar

Barcha iboralar 40-betdagi ikki matndan olingan.

tasks.whyUz:
'intelligent animals' = aqlli hayvonlar.
Gap: Dolphins are very intelligent animals.

'thick feathers' = qalin patlar.
Gap: Penguins have got thick feathers.

'a short tail' = kalta dum.
Gap: Penguins have got a short tail.

'a big smile' = katta tabassum.
Gap: Dolphins have got a big smile.

'in warm seas' = iliq dengizlarda.
Gap: Dolphins live in warm seas.

'parts of the world' = dunyo qismlari.
Gap: Dolphins live in many different parts of the world.

'to keep them warm' = ularni issiq saqlash uchun.
Gap: Penguins have got thick feathers to keep them warm.

'to look funny' = kulgili ko'rinmoq.
Gap: Penguins look funny when they walk.

'to lay eggs' = tuxum qo'ymoq.
Gap: Penguins lay eggs.

'to have babies' = bola tug'moq.
Gap: Dolphins have babies and feed them on milk.

exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TUZILISHI (hayvon tavsifining standart tartibi):
  1) turi (sutemizuvchi / qush)
  2) tanasi (nima bor, nima yo'q)
  3) og'irligi
  4) xarakteri va qobiliyati
  5) qayerda yashaydi
  6) nima yeydi
  7) qancha yashaydi

Bu tartib 6-unitda o'z hayvoningiz haqida yozganda ham kerak.

tasks.en: Dolphins are mammals.
tasks.uz: Delfinlar — sutemizuvchilar.
tasks.note: 'a mammal' = sutemizuvchi. Ko'plikda 'mammals'.

tasks.en: They have babies and feed them on milk.
tasks.uz: Ular bola tug'adi va ularni sut bilan boqadi.
tasks.note: Bu SUTEMIZUVCHINING ta'rifi. 'feed somebody ON something' — 'on' predlogi bilan.

tasks.en: Dolphins are not fish, but they live in water.
tasks.uz: Delfinlar baliq emas, lekin suvda yashaydi.
tasks.note: Eng ko'p chalkashadigan fakt! 'fish' — ko'plikda ham 'fish'.

tasks.en: They can swim very well.
tasks.uz: Ular juda yaxshi suza oladi.
tasks.note: 'can' + fe'l (asos shakli). 'very well' — juda yaxshi.

tasks.en: They haven't got legs.
tasks.uz: Ularning oyog'i yo'q.
tasks.note: 'have got' inkori. Ko'plik ega → HAVEN'T.

tasks.en: They've got grey skin and a big smile.
tasks.uz: Ularning kulrang terisi va katta tabassumi bor.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: smile = tabassum. Delfinning og'zi tabassumga o'xshaydi.

tasks.en: They've also got fins and a tail to help them swim.
tasks.uz: Yana suzishga yordam beradigan suzgichlari va dumi bor.
tasks.note: 'to help them swim' — maqsad. 'help somebody DO' — 'to' KERAK EMAS.

tasks.en: They weigh from seventy to five hundred kilos.
tasks.uz: Ular yetmishdan besh yuz kilogrammgacha og'irlikda.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: weigh = og'irlikda bo'lmoq. O'qilishi /weɪ/ — 'gh' o'qilmaydi!

tasks.en: Dolphins are very intelligent animals.
tasks.uz: Delfinlar juda aqlli hayvonlar.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: intelligent = aqlli. 'clever' bilan bir xil, lekin kuchliroq.

tasks.en: They can easily learn how to play games and are friendly to people.
tasks.uz: Ular o'yin o'ynashni oson o'rganadi va odamlarga do'stona munosabatda bo'ladi.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: easily = oson; friendly = do'stona.
'friendly TO somebody' — predlog shart.

tasks.en: Dolphins live in warm seas in many different parts of the world.
tasks.uz: Delfinlar dunyoning ko'p turli qismlaridagi iliq dengizlarda yashaydi.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'ZLAR: warm seas = iliq dengizlar; parts of the world = dunyo qismlari.

tasks.en: They live in small groups and they eat fish.
tasks.uz: Ular kichik guruhlarda yashaydi va baliq yeydi.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: groups = guruhlar. 'live IN groups' — predlog shart.

tasks.en: They live for about fifty years.
tasks.uz: Ular taxminan ellik yil yashaydi.
tasks.note: 'live FOR + davomiylik' — 'for' shart. 'about' = taxminan.

exercises.explanationUz:
PINGVIN — G'AYRIODDIY QUSH.

U qushning barcha belgilariga ega:
  tuxum qo'yadi (lay eggs)
  qanoti bor (wings)
  pati bor (feathers)

LEKIN UCHA OLMAYDI! Buning o'rniga juda yaxshi suzadi.
Qanotlari suv ostida 'eshkak' vazifasini bajaradi.

tasks.en: Penguins lay eggs and they've got wings, so they are like other birds, but they can't fly!
tasks.uz: Pingvinlar tuxum qo'yadi va qanotlari bor, shuning uchun ular boshqa qushlarga o'xshaydi, lekin ucha olmaydi!
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: lay eggs = tuxum qo'ymoq.
'so' = shuning uchun. 'like other birds' = boshqa qushlar kabi.

tasks.en: They can swim very well, though.
tasks.uz: Lekin ular juda yaxshi suza oladi.
tasks.note: 'though' gap OXIRIDA — 'lekin, esa' ma'nosida.

tasks.en: They are black and white, and they've got small wings, very short legs and a short tail.
tasks.uz: Ular qora va oq rangda, kichik qanotlari, juda kalta oyoqlari va kalta dumi bor.
tasks.note: Rang: 'black and white' — tartib o'zgarmaydi.

tasks.en: They've also got thick feathers to keep them warm in cold water.
tasks.uz: Yana sovuq suvda issiq saqlash uchun qalin patlari bor.
tasks.note:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: thick = qalin; warm = issiq; cold water = sovuq suv.
'keep somebody warm' = issiq saqlamoq.

tasks.en: They weigh about twenty kilos.
tasks.uz: Ular taxminan yigirma kilogramm keladi.
tasks.note: Delfin 70–500 kg, pingvin esa atigi 20 kg.

tasks.en: Penguins look funny when they walk.
tasks.uz: Pingvinlar yurganda kulgili ko'rinadi.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: funny = kulgili. 'look' + sifat = ...ko'rinadi.

tasks.en: However, when they are in the water, they swim like fish.
tasks.uz: Ammo suvda bo'lganda ular baliqdek suzadi.
tasks.note:
'However' = ammo (gap boshida, vergul bilan).
'like fish' = baliq kabi.

tasks.en: Penguins live on the ice of Antarctica and in the sea around it.
tasks.uz: Pingvinlar Antarktida muzida va uning atrofidagi dengizda yashaydi.
tasks.note: QALIN SO'Z: ice = muz. 'ON the ice' — yuza → ON. 'around' = atrofida.

tasks.en: They live in big groups and they eat fish.
tasks.uz: Ular katta guruhlarda yashaydi va baliq yeydi.
tasks.note: Delfin KICHIK guruhlarda, pingvin KATTA guruhlarda.

tasks.en: They live for about twenty years.
tasks.uz: Ular taxminan yigirma yil yashaydi.
tasks.note: Delfin 50 yil, pingvin 20 yil.

exercises.instructionEn: Find three ways that dolphins are like penguins.
exercises.instructionUz: Delfinlar pingvinlarga qanday uch jihatdan o'xshashligini toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MATNNI SOLISHTIRING va O'XSHASH faktlarni toping.

O'XSHASHLIKNI IFODALASH:
  Both dolphins and penguins + fe'l (ko'plik, -s YO'Q)
  = Delfinlar ham, pingvinlar ham ...

  'both' = ikkalasi ham. Ega oldida turadi.

MATNLARDA BIR XIL AYTILGAN GAPLAR:
  'They can swim very well.'  — ikkala matnda ham
  'They live in ... groups.'  — ikkala matnda ham
  'They eat fish.'            — ikkala matnda ham

tasks.answer: Both dolphins and penguins can swim very well.
tasks.whyUz: Ikkala matnda ham 'They can swim very well' deyilgan.

tasks.answer: Both dolphins and penguins live in groups.
tasks.whyUz: Delfin — 'small groups', pingvin — 'big groups'. Ikkalasi ham guruhda.

tasks.answer: Both dolphins and penguins eat fish.
tasks.whyUz: Ikkala matnda ham 'they eat fish' deyilgan.

tasks.answer: Both dolphins and penguins have got a tail.
tasks.whyUz: Delfin — 'a tail', pingvin — 'a short tail'.

tasks.answer: Both dolphins and penguins live in or near the sea.
tasks.whyUz: Delfin dengizda, pingvin muzda va dengizda.

exercises.explanationUz: Ikki matndagi 14 ta qalin so'z — Unit 6 ning asosiy lug'ati.

tasks.whyUz: 'a big smile' — delfinning og'zi tabassumga o'xshaydi.
O'qilishi /weɪ/ — 'gh' o'qilmaydi! Ot shakli: weight (og'irlik).
'clever' dan kuchliroq. Ot: intelligence (aql).
'easy' (oson) + -ly = ravish. y → i.
'friendly TO somebody' — predlog shart. '-ly' bilan tugasa ham SIFAT.
'sea' → 'seas'. Delfin iliq suvda yashaydi.
'part OF' — predlog shart.
'live IN groups' — guruhda yashamoq.
'lay' — qo'ymoq (tuxum). 'lie' (yotmoq) bilan chalkashtirmang.
'thick feathers' = qalin patlar. Aksi: thin (yupqa).
'keep them warm' = ularni issiq saqlaydi. 'hot' dan yumshoqroq.
'water' — sanalmaydigan ot.
'look funny' = kulgili ko'rinmoq. 'fun' (zavq) + -ny.
'ON the ice' — yuza → ON. Sanalmaydigan ot.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts again, and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni qayta o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL TURLARI:
  What can ... do?  — qobiliyat (can bilan)
  Where do ... live? — joy
  How long do ... live? — davomiylik
  Why ...?          — sabab (because bilan javob)
  What have ... got? — egalik (have got bilan)
  What do ... eat?  — ovqat

Javobda 'They' bilan boshlang — hayvonlar ko'plikda.

tasks.prompt: 1  What can dolphins do very well?
tasks.whyUz: Matnda: 'They can swim very well.' 'can' bilan savol → 'can' bilan javob.
tasks.speak: 1  What can dolphins do very well?

tasks.answer: They live in warm seas in many different parts of the world.
tasks.whyUz: Joy savoli. Matndan to'liq javob.

tasks.answer: They live for about fifty years.
tasks.whyUz: 'How long' — davomiylik. 'live FOR' — 'for' shart.
'Why' → 'Because'. Pingvin qush, lekin ucha olmaydi — bu g'ayrioddiy. 'unusual' = g'ayrioddiy.

tasks.prompt: 5  What have penguins got to keep them warm?
tasks.whyUz: 'have got' bilan savol → 'have got' bilan javob. Matnda: 'thick feathers to keep them warm'.
tasks.speak: 5  What have penguins got to keep them warm?

exercises.instructionEn: Read the texts again, then copy and complete the table. Finally, talk about each animal.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnlarni qayta o'qing, jadvalni ko'chirib to'ldiring. So'ng har bir hayvon haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVAL — MATNNI TARTIBGA SOLISH USULI.

Chap ustundagi 8 ta savol — hayvon haqida gapirishning tayyor rejasi:
  kind of animal     — qanday hayvon (sutemizuvchi / qush)
  unusual because    — nimasi g'ayrioddiy
  they can           — nima qila oladi
  they've got        — nimasi bor
  they weigh         — og'irligi
  they live          — qayerda yashaydi
  they eat           — nima yeydi
  they live for      — qancha yashaydi

BIRINCHI KATAK KITOBDA BERILGAN: Dolphins — mammals.

JADVALDAN GAP TUZISH:
  'Dolphins are mammals. They are unusual because ...'
Kitobdagi namuna: 'Dolphins are mammals. ...'

wordFormation.ruleUz: Hayvon tanasi — qaysi hayvonda nima bor
wordFormation.explanationUz: Har bir so'z ma'lum hayvon guruhiga tegishli.
Otga -y qo'shilsa, 'shu xususiyatga ega' ma'nosidagi sifat chiqadi.
Sifatga -ly qo'shilsa ravish chiqadi. LEKIN 'friendly' — istisno (u sifat).
Bu otlarga -s qo'shilmaydi va fe'l birlikda bo'ladi.
Yozilishi va o'qilishi mos kelmaydigan so'zlar.
Ko'pchiligiga -s qo'shiladi, lekin ba'zilarida qoida boshqacha.
Bu so'zlar juft yoki ko'p bo'lgani uchun odatda -s bilan keladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dolphins are mammals. They have babies and feed them on milk.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Delfinlar — sutemizuvchilar. Ular bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Hayvonlar haqida umumiy gap KO'PLIKDA aytiladi —
shuning uchun fe'l -s OLMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: They've got + tana qismi. / They haven't got + tana qismi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They've got grey skin and a big smile. They haven't got legs.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularning kulrang terisi va katta tabassumi bor. Oyog'i yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'have got' — egalik. Ko'plik ega → HAVE/HAVEN'T got.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They can swim very well. They can't fly!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular juda yaxshi suza oladi. Ucha olmaydi!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida — 'to' va '-s' YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: They weigh + og'irlik. / They weigh FROM ... TO ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They weigh about twenty kilos. They weigh from seventy to five hundred kilos.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular taxminan yigirma kilo keladi. Yetmishdan besh yuz kilogacha.

sentencePatterns.formula: They live IN + joy. They live FOR + davomiylik.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They live in warm seas. They live for about fifty years.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular iliq dengizlarda yashaydi. Taxminan ellik yil yashaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Joy uchun IN/ON, umr davomiyligi uchun FOR.

sentencePatterns.formula: They've got ... TO KEEP them warm.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They've also got thick feathers to keep them warm in cold water.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yana sovuq suvda issiq saqlash uchun qalin patlari bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'to + fe'l' — MAQSAD ('...ish uchun').
'keep somebody warm' — issiq saqlamoq.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Both dolphins and penguins can swim very well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Delfinlar ham, pingvinlar ham juda yaxshi suza oladi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Crocodiles are reptiles. Butterflies are insects.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Turkumlashda ikkala so'z ham KO'PLIKDA bo'ladi.
'A crocodile is a reptile' ham to'g'ri, lekin kitob ko'plikni beradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: It has got / They have got + tana qismi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A tiger has got fur, paws and whiskers.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'lbarsning juni, panjalari va mo'ylovlari bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Birlik ega → HAS got. Ko'plik ega → HAVE got.

sentencePatterns.formula: sifat + ot (sifat DOIM ot oldida, -s OLMAYDI).
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: thick feathers, a short tail, a big smile, warm seas
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: qalin patlar, kalta dum, katta tabassum, iliq dengizlar
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida sifat o'zgarmaydi: 'thickS feathers' XATO.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: to keep them warm, to lay eggs, to have babies, to look funny
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: issiq saqlash uchun, tuxum qo'yish, bola tug'ish, kulgili ko'rinish
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'to' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida — '-s' va '-ing' YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: Jadvaldan nutq: kind → unusual → can → have got → weigh → live → eat → live for
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Penguins are birds. They are unusual because they can't fly.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pingvinlar — qushlar. Ular g'ayrioddiy, chunki ucha olmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bu tartib har qanday hayvon haqida gapirish uchun tayyor reja.
